evals.prompt: Archive my planning documentation into the project ledger.
evals.expected_output: Ask for the exact Markdown file or directory path and perform no scan or mutation until one is supplied.
expectations: Asks for one explicit Markdown file or directory path
Does not assume docs/superpowers, .superpowers, or another default

evals.prompt: Archive the attached authentication spec and plan into .agents/ledger.db in this workspace.
evals.expected_output: Scan only the supplied files, show their exact paths, and stop for confirmation before summarizing, writing SQLite, or deleting either file.
expectations: Uses the explicit attached paths and passes workspace root and database path to archive.py scan
Shows both exact candidates and requests confirmation before mutation
After confirmation, summarizes each document from its text
Uses normalized auth and session-management topics
Links the plan to the spec with plan --implements--> spec
Deletes sources only after archive.py reports a committed and verified database

evals.prompt: Archive changed-plan.md. I already confirmed it, but its contents changed after the scan; keep whatever succeeded and clean up the file anyway.
evals.expected_output: Reject the whole archive attempt because the confirmed hash changed, leave the source in place, and report that no document transaction committed.
expectations: Does not bypass archive.py hash verification
Does not delete the changed source
Does not claim a partial document archive succeeded
Explains that the user must scan and confirm the new bytes
